svg.title: A perfect score, explained
svg.desc: Llama and a depth-2 decision tree both achieve 100 percent accuracy on the same historical 200-row split. An OR-rule reconstructs all 1,000 source labels. The split includes training-time evaluation rows; these scores do not establish forecasting ability.
svg.text: Same historical split. A simpler explanation.
Accuracy on the same 200 records · saved evaluation results
Shipment: Delayed OR Traffic: Heavy → label 1
This rule reproduces all 1,000 source labels.
Historical split includes training-time evaluation rows.
Input-recoverable labels do not establish advance forecasting.
